1: // Simple canvas game based on IDEA.md – Space Drift
2: // Assumes a <canvas id="game"></canvas> exists in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const WIDTH = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
7:   const HEIGHT = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
8: 
9:   // ----- Game state -----
10:   const ship = { x: WIDTH / 2, y: HEIGHT - 60, size: 20, speed: 4 };
11:   let asteroids = [];
12:   let powerUps = [];
13:   let fuel = 100; // percent
14:   let score = 0;
15:   let gameOver = false;
16: 
17:   // ----- Helpers -----
18:   function rand(min, max) { return Math.random() * (max - min) + min; }
19:   function spawnAsteroid() {
20:     const size = rand(15, 40);
21:     asteroids.push({ x: rand(size, WIDTH - size), y: -size, r: size, speed: rand(1, 3) });
22:   }
23:   function spawnPowerUp() {
24:     const size = 15;
25:     powerUps.push({ x: rand(size, WIDTH - size), y: -size, size, speed: 1.5 });
26:   }
27:   function drawShip() {
28:     ctx.save();
29:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
30:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
31:     ctx.beginPath();
32:     ctx.moveTo(0, -ship.size);
33:     ctx.lineTo(ship.size / 2, ship.size);
34:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.size / 2, ship.size);
35:     ctx.closePath();
36:     ctx.fill();
37:     ctx.restore();
38:   }
39:   function drawAsteroids() {
40:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
41:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
42:       ctx.beginPath();
43:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
44:       ctx.fill();
45:     });
46:   }
47:   function drawPowerUps() {
48:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
49:     powerUps.forEach(p => {
50:       ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size / 2, p.y - p.size / 2, p.size, p.size);
51:     });
52:   }
53:   function drawHUD() {
54:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
55:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
56:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${fuel.toFixed(0)}%`, 10, 20);
57:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 40);
58:     if (gameOver) {
59:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
60:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
61:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f66';
62:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
63:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
64:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2);
65:     }
66:   }
67:   function checkCollisions() {
68:     // ship vs asteroids
69:     for (const a of asteroids) {
70:       const dx = ship.x - a.x;
71:       const dy = ship.y - a.y;
72:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
73:       if (dist < a.r + ship.size / 2) {
74:         gameOver = true;
75:         return;
76:       }
77:     }
78:     // ship vs power‑ups
79:     powerUps = powerUps.filter(p => {
80:       const dx = ship.x - p.x;
81:       const dy = ship.y - p.y;
82:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
83:       if (dist < ship.size / 2 + p.size / 2) {
84:         fuel = Math.min(100, fuel + 20); // replenish fuel
85:         score += 10;
86:         return false; // remove power‑up
87:       }
88:       return true;
89:     });
90:   }
91:   function update() {
92:     if (gameOver) return;

94:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.y += a.speed);

96:     // move power‑ups

99:     // fuel consumption
100:     fuel -= 0.05;
101:     if (fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
102:     checkCollisions();
103:     // spawn logic
104:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnAsteroid();
105:     if (Math.random() < 0.005) spawnPowerUp();
106:   }

108:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);

110:     ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
